messages.content:
Are we allowed to use lower-level languages, such as C++ or Rust, to build part of our agents for speed optimization?

I understand that the entry point for execution is the main.py file, but are we allowed to include compiled binaries or shared libraries from other languages that are called from the Python code as part of our submission? If so, is there any guidance on how this should be done, and what platform or architecture we should compile for?
messages.rawMarkdown:

messages.content:
Hi there,

This is permitted, as long as a main.py file is submitted and your code does not exceed allowable inference time. We do not provide guidance/troubleshooting on architecture, however.
